section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Door Lock Control System
title: DOOR LOCK CONTROL SYSTEM

content.text: INSPECTION OF DOOR LOCK CONTROL SWITCH

content.description: Door lock control switch terminal diagram showing 8-pin connector with pins numbered 1-8 in two rows

content.text: If continuity is not as specified, replace the switch.

content.description: Key unlock switch diagram showing door handle assembly with key cylinder and continuity tester connection points labeled 1 and 2

items: (a) Check that there is continuity between terminals when the switch pin is pushed.
(b) Check that there is no continuity between terminals when the switch is free.

content.text: If operation is not as specified, replace the switch.

content.description: Door lock relay terminal diagram showing 6-pin relay connector with continuity tester attached

items: (a) Check that there is continuity between terminals 2, 3 and 4.
(b) Check that there is no continuity between terminals 1, 2 and 6.

content.text: If continuity is not as specified, replace the relay.

content.description: Door lock relay operation test diagram showing battery connections to relay terminals with positive lead to terminal 2 and negative lead to terminals 3 and 4

items: (a) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 2. Connect the negative (–) lead to terminals 3 and 4.
(b) Check that there is continuity between terminals 1 and 4.
(c) Check that there is continuity between terminals 3 and 6.

content.text: If there is no continuity, replace the relay.
